title: Reeva NDE 2318
content: I was five years old. I had measles and very, very high fever. I was at home because they could not shift me to a hospital. The doctor was not too sure if I'd make it through the night. What I was most aware and awestruck by was seeing myself in my bed. But it wasn't scary it was peaceful. I saw my grandma asleep in a chair next to me. I saw my parents in the next room asleep and my other grandma in the third bedroom asleep. The walls of the house were just not there. I was moving towards a beautiful bright light just like the moon but sending out long rays of light that I was going towards. I kept going higher and higher towards the light and saw myself and my family get smaller. Then suddenly my grandma woke up, opened her prayer book and started praying. Next thing I knew I was being sucked down towards my body and landed in with a thump. My parents say I was in a coma for about three weeks and couldn't even open my eyes. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 06/01/1980 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness Life threatening event, but not clinical death How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I could see more, feel the fear of my family, and I could see through walls as if they were not there. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was closest to the light. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could see more clearly and walls did not exist I could see past them. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes A big bright light like the moon but with long rays which seemed to embrace me - I was following the rays to their source. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Neither What emotions did you feel during the experience? Peace, contentment. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Zoroastrian Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Moderate Zoroastrian Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I could somehow always know when something was wrong with a person I loved. Could on some occasions know before a person passed away. Now I am also a medium. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes As soon as I was well and could talk I told my mum, but nobody else. I somehow felt it was too personal and maybe unbelievable to share with others. Mum was amazed and very supportive - she still is. Now others do know, some close friends and my husband. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Measles with very high fever; doctor not sure she would make it through the night; reported coma about three weeks.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived moving upward toward a bright light; then felt 'sucked down' back into the body after grandmother began praying.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE observing self/family at home, then movement upward toward bright light (no tunnel), then abrupt return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Walls of the house 'were just not there' (could see through walls). Return seemed triggered when grandmother woke and began praying.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The walls of the house were just not there.” “I was moving towards a beautiful bright light just like the moon but sending out long rays of light...” “Next thing I knew I was being sucked down towards my body and landed in with a thump.”
